name: Alistair MacLeod
bio:
Alistair's journey into motorsport began during his university days, where he volunteered at a local rally team, troubleshooting their archaic data logging systems. He quickly realized the critical role IT plays in modern racing. After graduating with a degree in Computer Science, he spent several years honing his skills in the tech industry before returning to motorsport, determined to bring cutting-edge solutions to the pit lane.

Alistair approaches his role with a meticulous attention to detail, ensuring that every system is robust, reliable, and secure. He's not just about keeping the lights on; he's passionate about leveraging data to improve performance and give his team a competitive edge. His calm demeanor under pressure and dedication to finding innovative solutions make him a valuable asset to any team.

His experience ranges from cloud infrastructure and database management to telemetry analysis and secure data transmission, Alistair is a skilled IT systems manager. He is motivated by the challenge of working with complex systems in a high-stakes environment.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight side part
physical.description: Alistair is of average height with a slightly athletic build.

quirks: Always has a packet of Scottish shortbread on his desk.
Refuses to use cloud services that aren't hosted in the UK.
Insists on writing all code documentation in Markdown.
